paragraphs: Mentioned at the end of Megillah, chapter 2, halakhah 2: he was sitting before Rabbi Zeira and dozed off. Rabbi Zeira told him, “Go back and repeat, for you did not concentrate.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: פ״ב סה״ב is read as chapter 2 end of halakhah 2. The separately read Guggenheimer Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 2:2 passage has Menasheh sitting before full ריבי Zeira and dozing, followed by חזור לך דלא כוונית. This supports the retained Rabbi title and go-back sense in this exact episode; Hyman instead supplies חזור בך.

The terse אמר ליה leaves the speaker implicit; Zeira addressing Menasheh is the natural narrative reading. Go back and repeat interprets the context, rather than translating a separate verb repeat; retract remains a general lexical alternative, while the former rebuke gloss is unsupported. The negation and lack of concentration remain. The digital check does not prove a printed end-of-halakhah position.
